scope: Selected Fortran Template Library instantiations: integer dynamic arrays and ftlString-to-integer hash maps, plus their unmodified support modules. A checksum-guarded adapter adds CPP-disabled module/dependency declarations so FPM 0.12 can discover modules emitted by templates. Original and adapted compiler-preprocessed output match apart from blank lines. Implicit-external checking is left at the upstream convention to avoid a GNU diagnostic in a character-length specification expression. The checked main verifies array growth, contents and pop, map insertion/replacement, presence, lookup and erase, then explicitly deletes both containers. Sources otherwise remain unchanged, and template headers remain in the source archive. Other instantiations, general algorithms, regex and every ownership/finalization case are not offered or validated.
compatibility_edits: CPP-disabled module/dependency declarations for FPM scanner; preprocessed nonblank code unchanged.
